tools.name: search
tools.description: Find securities in Equity Rank's coverage universe by ticker or company name. Returns up to 10 matches with the id to pass to `fetch` and the public page URL to cite. Use this first when you only have a company name.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Retrieve Equity Rank's public valuation summary for one security by id (its ticker, as returned by `search`): current price, blended model fair value estimate, margin-of-safety differential, method-agreement counts, Fundamental Strength score, next earnings date, and the last-updated stamp. Returns

tools.name: get_stock_valuation
tools.description: Structured public valuation data for one ticker — the same payload as GET https://api.equity-rank.com/api/stocks/{TICKER}/public: price, consensus_fair_value (the blended model estimate), mos_pct (margin-of-safety differential, %), method_agreement_above/below/total, fundamental_strength score and g

tools.name: list_sector_stocks
tools.description: Equity Rank's public sector index: the top scored securities in a sector, ranked by Equity Rank Score, with margin-of-safety differential, P/E, market cap, and dividend yield per row. Sectors: technology, healthcare, financials, consumer discretionary, consumer staples, industrials, energy, material

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
